title: Fatal Accident in Maceió Leaves Woman Dead, Man Injured
seoTitle: Fatal Crash in Maceió: Woman Dies, Man Injured
subtitle: Motorcycle Collides with Pole on Ladeira de Fernão Velho, Mobilizing Rescue and Forensic Teams
excerpt: A woman died and a man was injured when the motorcycle they were riding collided with a public lighting pole on Ladeira de Fernão Velho, in Maceió, early Sunday.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
A motorcycle collision with a public lighting pole on Ladeira de Fernão Velho, in Maceió, resulted in the death of a woman and the injury of a man in the early hours of Sunday, 27. The incident gained prominence due to its fatal nature and the mobilization of emergency services.

What Happened on Ladeira de Fernão Velho

According to preliminary information, the motorcycle lost control before hitting the pole, causing the woman riding as a passenger to die at the scene. The driver, who received first aid from the Mobile Emergency Medical Service (Samu), was taken to the State General Hospital (HGE) in Trapiche da Barra.

How Emergency Teams Acted

Rescue, traffic, and forensic teams were immediately called to the scene. The Municipal Department of Transport and Traffic (DMTT) cordoned off the area and directed vehicle traffic while the Institute of Criminalistics' forensic team gathered information from the road and the vehicle.

Investigation Procedures

The capital's Traffic Accidents and Offenses Police Department is expected to lead the investigation, compiling forensic results and other elements that help understand the conditions under which the motorcycle was traveling at the time of the collision.

Victim's Body Destination

The woman's body was sent to the Medical Legal Institute (IML) in Maceió for legal procedures. As of the release of the initial information, the names of those involved had not been disclosed.

Impact on the Local Community

The accident occurred on a stretch of road that provides access to the Fernão Velho neighborhood, an area known for intense traffic. The incident reinforces the need for extra caution when riding motorcycles on roads with public lighting and signage that require special attention.

With information from Francês News.
